description: Item 1: the cumulant->MeV map is a cluster expansion — the deuteron's LINEAR B=√5·E_unit·ladder is the pair order, the He4-local LOG b₄=−ln det is a connected many-body order; same E_unit anchor. Resolves the #4093 'linear-vs-log inconsistency' as a category error (pair term vs 4-body cumulant; 5g linear vs -ln det2 ~ g^2 quadratic). Deuteron pair-order matches AME to 6 digits; 4He = 6 pair terms + many-body (b3+b4) remainder. Does not derive E_unit or close the b4 magnitude. Forward, no fit, audit-only.
tier: structural reconciliation (corpus-documented deuteron law + exact cluster arithmetic)

result.E_unit_status: the ONE open dimensional anchor (provenance audit §2e); used here as the shared MeV unit across cluster orders, NOT fitted.
result.cluster_expansion: B(K) = E_unit * [ Σ_pairs (linear pair term) + Σ_{k>=3} b_k (connected k-body cumulants) ]

V1_deuteron_pair_order_linear.note: the ladder (1 - x/10 + 3x^2/200) fixes the +0.41% that bare 5g=2.2336 carries.

V2_category_error_different_orders.note: 5g is LINEAR in g (pair order); -ln det2 ~ g^2 is QUADRATIC (4-body cumulant). Different powers => different cluster orders, not a normalization mismatch. This is the #4093 category error, resolved.

V3_He4_cluster_structure.note: 4He = 6 pair terms (13.35 MeV) + connected many-body (b3+b4, ~15 MeV), with b4 the #4084 near-pole enhancement; same E_unit. Coheres with observed rho4~13 >> 6.

verdict.classification: RESOLUTION (forward, no new fit) — the #4093 cumulant->MeV 'inconsistency' is a category error; linear (pair) and log (many-body) are different orders of one cluster expansion with a single E_unit anchor.
verdict.still_open: E_unit itself (the dimensional anchor, provenance §2e) and the b4 magnitude (#4084) remain open; this fixes the FRAMEWORK, not those two.
